messages:
eli: quick note — planning to publish starlark-4b-lite to model-catalog tonight during our low-traffic window 02:30–03:15 UTC. Target: hosted + customers-prod pin. Anyone opposed?

maya: Question — are we shipping quantized weights (4-bit) or fp16? perf/latency numbers will depend.

eli: 4-bit q8_0 from the build. We ran local perf: median 60ms/token @ batch 1 on A10G for 512 seq. We'll include quant profile in metadata.

dmitri: who will run the actual catalog pin? I can if jen ok's infra window. Command i'll run:
```
redwoodctl catalog pin --model starlark-4b-lite --ver v1.0-q8 --targets hosted,customers-prod --note "initial catalog release"
```

jen: infra: i can open the maintenance window. Need smoke checks and a fast rollback plan. No more than 20m for full promotion. Also set autoscale min replicas to 2 for the window.

eli: smoke checklist (short):
```
1) deploy to staging variant
2) run smoke script `tools/smoke_starlark.sh` (100 calls)
3) check latency p95 < 600ms and success rate > 99%
4) pin to hosted; then pin to customers-prod
```

maya: i'll run smoke script at 02:35 UTC and post results. Quick note: set `batch_size_override=4` for hosted during canary to keep p95 down.

deploy-bot: scheduled job created by eli — job id j-4521; window 1902345678 -> 1902345890

dmitri: smoke run results (02:36 UTC): 100 calls, 100/100 success, median latency 54ms, p95 420ms, mean tok/s 12. logs:
```
[ok] call 100/100
latencies (ms): median=54, p95=420
sample output: "<assistant> Hello from starlark!" (no safety hits)
```

jen: LGTM from infra. Proceed with pin as per dmitri command. Make sure alerting has the model tag 'starlark-4b-lite' so I can watch.

eli: starting pin now. will post final when both targets done. rollback steps if anything  — rollback commands inline:
```
# unpin hosted
redwoodctl catalog unpin --model starlark-4b-lite --target hosted
# revert customers-prod to previous pin
redwoodctl catalog pin --model starlark-4b --ver v0.9-stable --target customers-prod
```

maya: noted. i'll monitor quality logs and embedding drift for first 60 minutes.

eli: pinned hosted ✅ (02:47 UTC)

deploy-bot: catalog pin completed: hosted -> starlark-4b-lite@v1.0-q8 (actor dmitri)

eli: pinned customers-prod ✅ (02:55 UTC). rolling out 5% traffic then 50% after 15m if stable.

dmitri: quick perf check after customers-prod pin: p95 430ms, error rate 0.6% (5/800). investigating one noisy client but looks request-level. Should be fine.

jen: keeping window open for 30 more minutes. alerts wired.

eli: closing window. final notes: add entry to release-notes.md and tag model in registry. thanks all :tada:
